steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Are you sure we're on the right track?

The Ferris wheel is lit by colorful lights, with music playing in the background. It turns slowly, bathed in the red light of the Black Ring, surrounded by howling monsters. Dancing black tentacles are vaguely visible.
So showy, so outlandish. It's as if it were beckoning you to come near.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: Come here, come to me... I understand your pain, your fear, and the emptiness in your heart. I have built you a most beautiful amusement park...
Phantom Hamel's laughter swirls around the park, reaching deep inside everyone present.

steps.speaker: Hamel
steps.content: The party has started. You can have everything you want in this carnival. The only thing I ask in return is your love...

steps.speaker: Monsters
steps.content: Complete me... Save me... I love you... Hamel...
Like pious worshipers, the monsters make their way toward the Ferris wheel, which is giving out wave after wave of eerie light. They are offering themselves up to those hellish tentacles.
They surge toward the owner of the Black Ring, blocking all the paths leading to the Ferris wheel.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is the power of <color=#fb9259>Catalyst Tendency</color>. Catalyst Sinners can inflict much deeper mental interference than other Sinners. In a Black Ring like this, she's more dangerous than Zoya.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Everyone in this carnival is under her bewitchment. They're gonna be consumed at the end of the parade.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, you just went through multiple attacks on your psyche, and were hurt by that man's black flame. Can you still carry on?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I can. We can't wait any longer.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We must act fast, we must remove the Corpus before she becomes too strong for us to take on.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Got it. Hella, get ready to fight.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You decide the path we are gonna take, and we'll clear it for you.
